title: The Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored…
description: The Forminator Forms plugin for WordPress up to version 1.58.4 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'textarea-N' parameter used for rich-text draft values saved as Save-and-Continue drafts. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when any user, including administrators, resumes the draft or accesses the draft link. The exploit requires the targeted form to have a Rich-Text Textarea field with Save-and-Continue enabled and public submission permissions.
